==> quadlet/mylab-caddy.container
# Generated by MyLab. Do not edit: changes will be overwritten.

[Unit]
Description=MyLab: reverse proxy (Caddy)

[Container]
ContainerName=mylab-caddy
Image=localhost/mylab-caddy:latest
Network=mylab-proxy.network
PublishPort=80:80
PublishPort=443:443
PublishPort=443:443/udp
Volume=/var/lib/mylab/caddy:/etc/caddy:ro
Volume=/var/lib/mylab/caddy-data:/data
Secret=mylab-caddy-dns-token,type=env,target=DNS_API_TOKEN
Label=io.mylab.service=_system
Label=io.mylab.component=caddy

[Service]
ExecReload=/usr/bin/podman exec mylab-caddy caddy reload --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

==> caddy/Caddyfile
# Generated by MyLab. Do not edit: changes will be overwritten.
{
	email admin@example.com
}

*.lab.example.com {
	tls {
		dns cloudflare {env.DNS_API_TOKEN}
	}
	@mylab-admin host mylab.lab.example.com
	handle @mylab-admin {
		@mylab-admin-external not remote_ip private_ranges 100.64.0.0/10
		abort @mylab-admin-external
		reverse_proxy host.containers.internal:8480
	}

	import sites/*.caddy

	# Unknown subdomains get no response.
	handle {
		abort
	}
}
